title_zh: 忘关猫耳朵特效的家庭视频通话
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (19/20): The Family Video Call with Cat Ears Left On
note_en: 反而 marks a result that goes against expectations: 两人笑完之后，反而更容易开口 "after they'd had a good laugh, it was actually easier to open up." You'd expect the silly filter to ruin a serious talk; 反而 tells the reader the opposite happened. English signals this with "actually" or "if anything," but 反而 must sit right before the verb phrase.
